hypotheses.model: WIN_raw ~ season intercepts (A, B) + b * confidence; claim b > 0, sign only
hypotheses.estimator: pipeline/report.py wild_p_k: restricted wild cluster bootstrap-t, null drops confidence and keeps both season intercepts; Rademacher >= 12 clusters else Webb; B = 9999
hypotheses.sample: seasonA + seasonB events: S2 PASS AND stage-2 T2 frozen under the H-T2C protocol before entry open - 15 min AND graded exit A, not VOID

protocol.code: pipeline/dossier.py and pipeline/t2_stage2.py at the hashes of registry/D004_implementation_v4.sha256 as frozen 2026-10-05
protocol.on_change: pooling ends for later events; the H-T2C protocol continues as a shadow on every PASS event (same freeze rule, never shown to live T2)
protocol.if_no_track_in_seasonB: UNTESTABLE - never tested on Season A alone

hypotheses.sensitivity: no_price VOID coded WIN = 0, reported beside the verdict; disagreement is a stated threat
hypotheses.size_disclosure: if one entry session holds > 25% of the pooled sample, carry v2's 6.5% unequal-cluster size
hypotheses.verdict_at: Gate 2, after Season B grading; Season A interim descriptive only, never used to choose Season B's screen, universe or BUY rule
